rationale.conceptual: The method combines several non-trivial components: fitting anharmonic potentials from DFT energies, self-consistent harmonic and exact quantum frequency calculations, deformation potential averaging over the Fermi surface, and electron-phonon coupling evaluation using anharmonic oscillator matrix elements. This is an established but multi-part algorithm that requires a solid understanding of solid-state physics and careful numerical implementation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves multiple stages: geometry relaxation, frozen-phonon scans over several displacements, data extraction, fitting, iterative self-consistent harmonic solution, numerical Schrödinger equation, deformation potential computation (requires band-structure data), and final coupling/ Tc/ isotope calculation. This amounts to a ~6-9 step workflow with dependency on DFT runs and custom post-processing scripts, which is a non-trivial orchestration but remains within a single toolset (Quantum ESPRESSO + Python).
